verdict.rationale: Claude is an AI assistant and model platform, not an equity or cap-table management system, so syncing HRIS/payroll stakeholders into equity records is a category error for this product. The documented directory sync (claude-docs-12) only provisions Claude workspace users and does not create or maintain equity records. Generic connectors to team tools are likewise not this capability, so neither makes the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an ops user, stakeholders sync from my HRIS/payroll system (e.g. Gusto, Rippling) so new hires and terminations flow into equity records automatically
